verdict.rationale: Gunderson Dettmer is a venture-focused law firm. An interactive developer API reference with runnable examples is outside what buyers comparing law firms would reasonably ask about. Its client tools (GDHQ, Contract Generator, D&O portal, ChatGD) are end-user or internal applications, not developer platforms, and nothing in the evidence shows an API being shipped. The 404 probes for OpenAPI and llms.txt fit this, but the verdict rests on the category mismatch rather than on missing evidence.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
